text.en:
Section 1 of Executive Order No. 448, dated
June 9, 1951, is hereby amended by increasing and setting
up new ceiling prices for Chapco Board as follows:
CONSTRUCTION MATERIAL (IMPORTED)
Wallboard: Chapco Board
Unit Wholesaler's Retailer's

The ceiling prices fixed in the Order include the
17 per cent Special Excise Tax on Foreign Exchange, 7
per cent Sales Tax and 1 per cent Municipal Tax on Shoe
Materials and construction materials and 7 per cent Sales
Tax and 1 per cent Municipal Tax on Foodstuff and
Poultry Feeds.

This Order shall take effect immediately.

OFFICIAS CAZORTH
Done in the City of Manila this 27th day of July, in
the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and ifty-one, and
of the Independence of the Philippines, the sixth.
EXPIDIO QUIRINO
President of the Philippines
3315
By the President:
MARCIANO ROQUE
Acting Assistant Executive Secretary
